Falling within the single-verse section (*Ekakanipāta*) attributed to enlightened elder nuns, the poem contains the spiritual verse associated with the therī Dhīrā. Modern English translations of the text include those by Bhikkhu Sujato and Ayya Soma, alongside translations into nine other modern languages [SuttaCentral].
